title: Cross-Lingual Transfer of Evil Vectors Is Directionally Asymmetric
abstract: arXiv:2610.17880v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Persona vectors are linear directions in the residual-stream activations of LLMs that encode behavioral traits and enable fine-grained control over model behavior. Among them, the evil persona vector is particularly relevant to understanding harmful behavior, jailbreak vulnerabilities, and the unlearning of harmful knowledge. Yet whether this vector reflects a genuinely cross-lingual concept, rather than an artifact of its extraction language, remains untested. We conduct a systematic evil-vector transfer study across two high-resource languages (English, Spanish) and two low-resource languages (Swahili, Telugu) on four open-source instruction-tuned LLMs, and find that transfer is directionally asymmetric. Evil vectors are harder to obtain reliably from low-resource languages, and the resulting vectors are largely ineffective at steering, even within their own language. translated_title: 邪恶向量的跨语言迁移具有方向不对称性
translated_abstract: 人格向量是大型语言模型残差流激活中的线性方向，它编码了行为特质，并能够对模型行为进行细粒度控制。其中，邪恶人格向量与理解有害行为、越狱漏洞以及有害知识的遗忘问题尤为相关。然而，该向量是否真正反映了一个跨语言的概念，而非其提取语言所带来的人为产物，这一问题尚未得到检验。我们在四个开源指令微调大语言模型上，针对两种高资源语言（英语、西班牙语）和两种低资源语言（斯瓦希里语、泰卢固语）开展了系统的邪恶向量迁移研究，发现这种迁移具有方向上的不对称性：从低资源语言中难以可靠地获得邪恶向量，且所得向量在引导模型行为方面大多无效，即使在其自身语言内也是如此；相比之下，从高资源语言中提取的向量则能够有效地跨语言迁移……
tldr: 本研究首次系统检验了邪恶人格向量的跨语言可迁移性，发现其迁移具有方向不对称性——从低资源语言难以可靠提取且基本无法有效引导模型行为，而从高资源语言提取的向量则能跨语言有效迁移。
en_tdlr: Evil persona vectors show directionally asymmetric cross-lingual transfer: vectors from low-resource languages are unreliable and largely ineffective at steering even within their own language, while vectors from high-resource languages transfer effectively across languages.
